item.title: EplayerX 1.2.21
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善下载服务中断后的恢复与重试，减少下载任务卡住或重复连接的问题。 - 优化播放进度缩略图的加载与取消，切换视频或关闭播放器时及时停止过期请求。 - 应用切到后台时暂停首页轮播和动态图标，减少不必要的资源占用，并改善切换应用时的稳定性。 - 改善播放器关闭后的资源释放，以及播放状态上报的稳定性。 - 优化 MoviePilot 设置页面和部分工具栏的布局与显示。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved download recovery and retries after service interruptions, reducing stalled tasks and duplicate connections. - Improved playback thumbnail loading and cancellation, stopping obsolete requests when switching videos or closing the player. - Paused Home carousels and animated icons while the app is inactive to reduce unnecessary resource use, and improved stability when switching apps. - Improved resource cleanup when closing the player and the reliability of playback status reporting. - Refined the MoviePilot settings page and several toolbar layouts.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
